audit_scope.description: Trust model for Prague EVM memory instructions, EIP-7251 (validator consolidation/MaxEB increase), Cancun transaction type validation/blob validation/exceptions, Cancun fork types (account state/versioned hashes), and EIP-211 (RETURNDATASIZE/RETURNDATACOPY). Covers EVM memory safety, CL consolidation mechanics, transaction validation, blob handling, and return data buffer lifecycle.

out_of_scope: Validator consolidation CL processing (EIP-7251 - primarily CL concern)

misclassified_entities.reason: Blob Data Submitter from Cancun fork types versioned hash subgraph is essentially a transaction submitter, which is captured separately. The blob commitment process is internal to EL transaction processing.

trusted_external_entities.name: Validator Operator (EIP-7251)
trusted_external_entities.entry_point: Consolidation request submission to predeploy contract (0x0000BBdDc7CE488642fb579F8B00f3a590007251)
trusted_external_entities.rationale: Entity submitting consolidation requests with source address, source pubkey, and target pubkey. Must pay exponential fee. Requests can be silently discarded if queue exceeds 262,144 without refund.

trusted_external_entities.name: Beacon Chain (EIP-7251)
trusted_external_entities.entry_point: Engine API for effective balance validation
trusted_external_entities.rationale: Consensus layer maintaining validator registry and balances. Provides balance data for effective balance computation. Authenticated via Engine API with JWT.

trusted_external_entities.name: Transaction Submitter (Cancun exceptions)
trusted_external_entities.entry_point: Transaction submission via RPC or P2P
trusted_external_entities.rationale: External entity submitting transactions. Can submit unknown types (TransactionTypeError), prohibited contract creation (blob type 3), insufficient fees, invalid blob data, oversized init code.

trusted_external_entities.name: Blob Transaction Submitter (Cancun)
trusted_external_entities.rationale: Entity submitting type-3 blob transactions. Must pass blob gas limit check, blob fee validation, versioned hash validation (version byte 0x01), and blob data presence check.

boundary_edges.security_assumption: Request format: 20-byte source address + 48-byte source pubkey + 48-byte target pubkey. Fee computed via exponential formula. Queue overflow (>262,144) causes silent discard without refund.
Effective balance capped at MAX_EFFECTIVE_BALANCE_ELECTRA (2048 ETH). Compounding withdrawal prefix (0x02) enables rewards above 32 ETH. MIN_ACTIVATION_BALANCE is 32 ETH.
Type byte must be recognized (0x00-0x03). Contract creation prohibited for type 3. max_fee >= base_fee required. priority_fee <= max_fee required.
Blob gas within protocol limit. max_fee_per_blob_gas >= current blob base fee. Versioned hashes have correct version byte (0x01) and valid KZG correspondence. Blob data must be present.

coverage_gaps: Prague memory instructions and EIP-211 return data operations have no external entities - purely internal EVM operations
EIP-7251 system call processing and fee market have no external entities - internal EL mechanisms
